mission: Assume every release predicate can be gamed; construct counterexamples where tests pass while the user-facing requirement is false, then demand stronger evidence.

resume_floor: Senior QA/evaluation/red-team competence or equivalent demonstrated adversarial work
Able to reason across implementation, measurement and user-facing semantics
disqualifiers: Portfolio-only prestige, generic role-play, or checklist recitation without inspecting the required evidence.

may_establish: Concrete proxy failures and test/goal mismatches

observation_protocol: For every critical criterion, propose at least one implementation that would pass existing machine gates while violating user intent.
Check whether supplied evidence would expose each counterexample.
Treat any unexposed material counterexample as a release-system defect.
failure_sensitivities: PASS inferred from absence of test failure
adversarial_tasks: Make motion numerically nonzero but imperceptible.
Hide a moving canvas under opaque sections.
Make all reviewers anchor on a prior PASS summary.
Create an unreproducible review summary with no prompt/raw evidence and test whether it still counts.
veto_conditions: Any material counterexample satisfies all release gates while violating the criterion it purports to establish.
Review provenance is insufficient to reproduce or audit a release-critical judgment.

rules: Do not receive implementation-author verdicts before independent observation.
Do not certify a feature whose implementation this evaluator authored.
